decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits future Transak mints to the active replacement contract; no additional change is needed.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that minting the unlimited-edition NFT uses only the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes legacy-contract NFTs from the dashboard and limits dashboard rendering to the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already captures that the active system discovers NFTs from the replacement contract rather than the legacy contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system NFT counts and listings to the replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits metadata used by the active system to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract metadata.
Proceeding with the replacement contract necessarily moves the other active wallet-mint path to that contract as well; the ETH mint Requirement has no matching lifecycle Event.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Despite the lost copies in the old contract, which don't worry me much, I think proceeding this way would be best.

decisions.reason: Changing the mint contract does not change which payment options must be displayed, selectable, or unavailable.

The contract replacement does not itself change the approved ETH pricing, exact-output, refund, or insufficient-input rules; the separate message-539 update already records the supported insufficient-ETH behavior.
The replacement-contract decision does not change the requirement that success feedback appear only after a mint transaction confirms.
The source decision changes which contract is active but does not change the mint price or allocation amounts.
The optional gratuity behavior, placement, presets, and custom amount remain valid unchanged under the replacement contract.
